r161/ordinary-prime-marked-low-spectrum.question: Can the original fixed gap be excluded via an o(T) marked inverse-square upper on the actual spectral window lambda<=A0/T?
r161/ordinary-prime-marked-low-spectrum.scope: Use the genuine least-energy true opposite optimizer, exact positive support, actual compressed Jacobi operator and marked forcing. Keep actual fixed floor and one admissible growing T. Generic source-free spectral gaps or rank bounds do not suffice.
r161/ordinary-prime-marked-low-spectrum.remaining: Control the narrow actual marked spectral band without critical size, or the full remaining moderate critical moment. Both O(p) critical and o(T) spectral uppers are open.

r161/ordinary-prime-centered-middle-grap.question: Can the centered exact physical graph bound a remaining middle-amplitude block with the true five weights?
r161/ordinary-prime-centered-middle-grap.scope: Keep the actual ratio constraint, physical x,y cut and phase. Both Fourier conventions and signs matter. Distinguish uncut graph orthogonality from the clean restriction after weighting.
r161/ordinary-prime-centered-middle-grap.remaining: Control the narrow actual marked spectral band without critical size, or the full remaining moderate critical moment. Both O(p) critical and o(T) spectral uppers are open.

r161/cold-actual-picard-increment.question: Can an actual signed estimate for the 601 to 602 Picard increment advance a source-local or two-vertex confinement?
r161/cold-actual-picard-increment.scope: Keep both actual heights, original square, physical t0=n and both lifts. A symbolic equality or a fixed-height residual second norm without transfer does not imply an invariant.
r161/cold-actual-picard-increment.remaining: Prove a useful signed estimate on the genuine Picard increment or a nonlinear invariant with a quantitative resolvent bridge.

comparison: The marked inverse-square band applies to every fixed gap and uses the exact complementary exterior forcing. The centered phase graph asks a different physical estimate on the remaining near-critical moderate layers. The cold Picard increment is an independent complex-domain test.
